meta.title: This Bizarre Town Actually Lives Underground #shorts
meta.description:
Imagine walking through a scorching desert, looking for a town, only to find nothing but chimneys sticking out of the dirt. Welcome to Coober Pedy, a real-life underground town in the Australian outback. It gets so hot here—over one hundred and ten degrees—that the residents decided to dig their homes right into the earth. Inside these dugouts, the temperature stays a perfect seventy-four degrees year-round, without any air conditioning. They have underground churches, bars, and even hotels for brave tourists. Some residents have even struck it rich by accidentally finding precious opal gemstones while expanding their living rooms. It sounds like a sci-fi movie, but it is completely real. Would you ever live in a dark underground home like this? Hit follow for more insane places on Earth!
